auszuege.business: King Slide Works Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, designs, manufactures, distributes, and sells rail kits for cloud servers, network communications, kitchen ware, and consumer electronics in Taiwan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company offers ultra-thin server slide rail kits, electronic device rail kits, and cable management arm for cloud computing data centers, as well as engages in international investment activities. It also provides kitchen and furniture solutions, including metal and wood drawer systems, inner drawers and pull-out systems, undermount slides, ball bearing slides, epoxy coated roller slides, hinges for home furniture, kitchen cabinets and workspace, and consumer electronics solutions. In addition, the company is involved in trading and wholesaling rail kits, slides, and accessories; manufacturing and selling mechanical rail kit products integrated into servers and network-related equipment; and manufacturing and selling rail kits for servers, network communications, data centers, and related peripheral components. Its products are used in home appliances, motorhomes and RVs, office equipment, medical storage, and other applications. King Slide Works Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
